audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart was flat 'Skill' on all 7 rows while the content win[] and packet chart say Qiyana on all 7.
audit.why: Assassin mirror where Qiyana's element CC (stun/slow) answers Talon's Q dash and Rake return; content layer and packet agree Qiyana holds every stage on skill-even play. 48.92% WR over 1478 games keeps it EVEN in rating terms.
audit.corrected: Full phases aligned to the content chart.

audit.why: Qiyana spikes at 3 (full element combo), 6 (wall-stun R), first item. Talon spikes at 2 (Q-W all-in) and 6 (Shadow Assault roams). spikes[] covers these.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content called Qiyana's R a 'water R AoE-slow' — Supreme Display of Talent STUNS on element detonation, it does not slow. breakdown.cooldowns had no digits. Two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: Riot kit text: R 'detonates whatever elements she hits, stunning and damaging nearby enemies'. Talon Rake (W) 9s rank 1 with return damage; Q 8s dash; Shadow Assault 100/80/60s; E vault has no meaningful cooldown per wall segment reuse. Both sides carry displacement (missing-interaction flag).
audit.corrected: R described as a stun; real cooldowns added; bleed bullets replaced.
